title: Fluxless TCB with in-situ Atmospheric Pressure Plasma Surface Treatment Enabling 25-micron Pitch Solder Micro-Bumps for 3D Integration
orgs: IBM Research, Albany, NY, USA; ASMPT Technology Hong Kong Limited; ASMPT Singapore Pte. Ltd
notes: Fluxless TCB with in-situ Ar/H2 plasma: 3D stack (die/TSV Si interposer/21 mm laminate, 150 um C4) and 25 um pitch Cu/Ni/Cu/SnAg microbump chip-to-chip; Cu-oxide coupons; TC 1000 cycles.

title: Integration and Characterization of Two Connection Schemes for Backside Power Delivery Network
notes: Wafer-level BSPDN front-back connections: TDV+BPR+nTSV with ~250 nm Si vs TDV-only with no Si; Mo vs TiN/W fill; TDV R, single-via C, self-heating 60 vs 100 K/mW.

title: Monolithic Passive Low-Loss Fiber Coupling to Photonic Glass Core Substrates using Ion-Exchanged Waveguides and SLE-Fabricated V-Grooves
orgs: Fraunhofer IZM; Technical University of Berlin
notes: Two-step Ag IOX waveguides plus fs-laser/KOH SLE V-grooves in D 263 T eco 100x100 mm panels; passive SMF edge coupling 1.756 dB at 1550 nm (n=5).

title: A Low-Cost 2.5D Photonic Silicon Interposer Assembly Process for HPC Applications
notes: 1x-reticle PIC interposer TV: TDV through BOX + open tapered TSV + offset C4, through-mold glass block. Only dims: 40/160 um min pitch. TM/SI/PI simulated.

title: Die-To-Wafer Hybrid Bonding Technology down to 1 um pitch for Multi-Die Stacking Integration
notes: TV1: 6x6 mm dies D2W hybrid bonded on 300 mm wafer, dual damascene DC at 5/3/2/1 um pitch, 400 C 2 h anneal, thinned to 8 um. IDGF, TOV, HD TSV short loops toward TV2.
